name: horizon
description: Unified developer tools ecosystem - Purpose, Gate, and Dream

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:packages && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace=@horizon/purpose-core && npm run build --workspace=@horizon/gate-core && npm run build --workspace=@horizon/scan-core
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@horizon/gate-sdk && npm run build --workspace=@horizon/gate-manager && npm run build --workspace=@horizon/dream-core && npm run build --workspace=@horizon/visualizer
